featured_reviews.name: ketan Ausarmal
featured_reviews.review_text: It is a wonderful place, my mind is at peace. Emperor Ashoka has done a lot of great and unforgettable work. The nature here is also very beautiful. Must visit, my mind will be at peace.

featured_reviews.name: vikrant mandiya
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is one of the original budhhist relic that survived today in modern India.

Built somewhere around 2 BCE....with just lime, bricks , stone n mud ..it's shows the peak of support what buddhism enjoyed in that era...today standing n ruin with maximum neglect from the concerned parties.

Still standing tall in the densely populated sub of palghar.

featured_reviews.name: Cedric Noronha
featured_reviews.review_text: An ancient Buddhist Stupa located at Nalasopara-Nirmal Road in Nalasopara. It was built around 3rd century BC during the Ashokan era and is maintained by ASI. This Stupa houses Buddha sculptures, circular platforms etc. There is a half buried pillar signifying that Gautam Buddha had visited this place. However, it is still not maintained properly. During monsoon, this Stupa is covered in blue plastic sheet. There is an entrance gate and a statue of Gautam Buddha a little further away from the actual entrance. Had admired the ancient site and posed for photographs as a college student. It is an ideal place for those who are interested in history.

featured_reviews.name: vivek puthran
featured_reviews.review_text: There's not much to say about a 2000 year old site. You have to come to this place and soak it in. You will get the vibes that you are standing amidst something really grand and beautiful.  You don't come across something as old as this. You have to make the effort to come to it. If you are into covering the ancient caves of Maharashtra  / Mumbai then this one should definitely be on your to do list 👍

featured_reviews.name: Greeshma Gowda
featured_reviews.review_text: The stupa is currently under repair so avoid going there now. The ruins are in the middle of a well maintained garden. You can take a shared auto from nallasopara train station to this site. While returning we had to wait for some time to catch an auto.

Sure! Here's a short and sweet Google review you can post for Chalo Chalo – A Cycling Group:

Had an amazing time riding with Chalo Chalo! Great hospitality, fun games, awesome vibes — everything was spot on. Super well-organized and welcoming. Looking forward to many more rides with this fantastic group🚲🤌🏽💯

featured_reviews.name: Rohit Kadoo
featured_reviews.review_text:
Hey! Just wanted to say a big thank you for organizing the Chalo Chale Cycling Tour! 🚴‍♂️✨
It was truly an awesome experience — got to explore the hidden beauty of Vasai through some really scenic and lesser-known routes.
Hats off to such a kind and passionate team of organizers for making it smooth, safe, and so much fun. Can’t wait for the next ride! 🌿💚

featured_reviews.name: Prerna Raut
featured_reviews.review_text:
I happened to know about Chale Chalo through Instagram. At first I was apprehensive. I am not a usual cyclist, used to cycle in childhood. But I decided to take the plunge after Rohit’s reassurance that the tour is going to be on a slow pace and also a great experience. Like he had said this was indeed one of the best experiences I have had till date. The ride was super smooth, he helped us guide through traffic. We saw the scenic lanes of interior Vasai, visited the fort (thanks to this tour my gallery is filled with amazing pictures now), put up tents on Suruchi beach, played games (revived childhood) which was followed by a scrumptious lunch by Chale Chalo itself.
Not only this tour helped overcome my inhibitions of riding a cycle again but I also ended meeting amazing people that day.
You might see me joining in these tours often 😜.
All in all 10/10. LOVED IT! A big thanks to Rohit and Ayushi ❤️

featured_reviews.name: Namita Lulla
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Beach Hopping tour organised by the Chalo Chale team is a wholesome experience of spending time amidst nature. Everything from meals and views to safety and comfort is well taken care of and people from all age groups can equally enjoy. Thank you team Chalo Chale!

Both Rohit and Ayushi along with Prasobh in their team are wonderful tour guides who have thoughtfully curated this tour to help you make the most of your experience. We got to spend a good amount of time at every beach and had fun playing games like dog and the bone and mafia. The group setting and the vibes were all perfect and I'm already looking forward to being a part of many such tours now. If you're taking time out of your schedule to be a part of the Chalo Chale tours, you won't regret it for sure. 💃✨

featured_reviews.name: Gaurav
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently went on a bicycle trip in Vasai and had a fantastic time. The trip was well-organized, Rohit and Ayushi, the team leads were friendly and helpful. They took us through the hidden lanes and bylanes of Vasai, and we got to see a side of the place that we wouldn't have otherwise. The route was picturesque, and the scenery was breathtaking.

I rode bicycle after 9 years and I was bit worried if I would able to complete the patch, however I found it easy and Chalo Chale team has backup to switch on scooty if tired.

I would definitely recommend this trip to anyone who loves nature and adventure.

featured_reviews.name: tangy twisters
featured_reviews.review_text:
A day filled with lot's of laughter and happiness. All unknown individuals met as a family ✨ Perfect trip to get out of your daily hustles and live out life beyond expectations freely❣️
Highly recommended must have experience with Chalo Chale and you'll surely keep going with them again and again for more trips for sure💯
Games, authentic food, cycling, beach, camping, self-time, peace ...Yes yes all the things you'll  experience in one day💖

The tour was wonderfully executed, with top notch cycles, safety great, breaks for food and water, interesting anecdotes and lots of laughter. Cannot wait till they have a plethora of options for different cycling tours.

name: Bhovara
description:
At Bhovara, we provide History Walks, Guided City Walks, Bicycle Rides, Photo Walks, Food Walks, Treks & Trails all over Maharashtra & Goa. We place more emphasis on Local Food, Home Stay, Off-beat Sight Seeing, History & Culture Exploration. Our Eco-friendly Trips are specially designed for Nature Lovers, Photographers, Bloggers, Vloggers, Trekkers, Students, Wanderers & Explorers.

Also, we take Group Bookings for Schools, Colleges, Corporate & all type of Organizations. So, Book Now & give us an opportunity to make your trip!

featured_reviews.name: ChelC FrosT
featured_reviews.review_text: I had such a wonderful time meeting people from so many parts of Bombay. The games, the cards and the train platform shenanigans will always be treasured. Atul is a treasure trove of lived experiences who has varied stories and learnings to share from all those he has encountered. I learnt some much about the Popti meal we shared and the wonderful hospitality of the family whose home was made accessible to us at Mauli village at Asangaon. It was also a pleasure to interact with such spirited souls who are looking to go beyond who they are and be who they were meant to be. Hope to meet all of you again and practice speaking more Marathi! God bless. ❤️

featured_reviews.review_text:
Achole Gaon Lake is a peaceful and lesser-known natural spot tucked away in the busy suburb of Nalasopara East. Surrounded by local greenery and open skies, the lake offers a refreshing escape from the fast-paced urban environment. It is especially beautiful during early mornings and evenings, when the calm water reflects the sky and creates a soothing atmosphere.
The lake attracts locals who come for walking, relaxing, or simply enjoying some quiet time. You’ll often see birds around the water, adding to its natural charm and making it a pleasant place for nature lovers and casual photographers. Unlike crowded tourist destinations, Achole Gaon Lake maintains a simple, raw appeal that feels authentic and grounded.
However, the area still has scope for improvement. Cleanliness and maintenance could be better, and proper seating or walking pathways would enhance the overall experience. With a little development and care, this lake has the potential to become a beautiful community spot.
Overall, Achole Gaon Lake is a hidden gem for those who appreciate calm, nature-filled surroundings without traveling far from the city.

We just returned from the most incredible 5-night getaway to the Maldives, and I'm still pinching myself to see if it was all just a dream. From the moment we arrived at our luxurious overwater villa, we knew we were in for a treat.

The resort exceeded our expectations in every way. The villa was stunning, with crystal-clear waters lapping beneath our private deck and breathtaking sunsets that left us speechless. The staff were warm, friendly, and attentive to our every need, making us feel like royalty.

The food was sublime, with an incredible array of fine dining options, fresh seafood, and local specialties. We indulged in decadent breakfast buffets, romantic candlelit dinners, and even had the chance to dine on the beach under the stars.

As we reluctantly checked out of our little slice of heaven, we both knew that this trip would stay with us forever. If you're looking for a romantic getaway, a relaxing escape, or just an unforgettable adventure, the Maldives is a must-visit destination.

Highlights:
- Luxurious overwater villa with breathtaking views
- Exceptional service from friendly and attentive staff
- Incredible fine dining options and fresh seafood
- Unforgettable snorkeling experiences
